name: Error Handler
info:
This subflow is a centralized errorhandler
for all HTTP request nodes in Parat-Bridge.

Receives errors from catch-nodes in all
subflows and:
1. Classifies the error(network, auth, not_found, rate_limit, server, client)
2. Logs the error to global context (error_log) writes to disc.
3. Counts errors per classification (failure_counts)
4. Sends notification to Rayvn and Wasos when more than 5 continuing errors from the same source happens.
    - Notifies again at 15, 25, 35... (every 10 error after first notification.)

name: Classify and log error
info:
Receives errors from catch nodes and:

1. Classifies the error by HTTP status code:
   - network: no connection (status 0/null) - critical
   - auth: 401/403 - critical
   - not_found: 404
   - rate_limit: 429
   - server: 5xx - critical
   - client: 4xx

2. Logs the error to global context (error_log, max 100 entries)
   - Persisted to disk via localfilesystem context storage

3. Counts failures per source node (failure_counts)

4. Sets msg properties for downstream nodes:
   - msg.errorEntry: full error details
   - msg.failureCount: total failures from this source
   - msg.isCritical: true if critical error type

name: Connection break: 5+ failures
info:
Switch node that checks if a source node has 
failed 5 or more times.

Passes the message downstream only if:
- msg.failureCount >= 5

If below threshold, message is dropped and
no notification is sent.

name: Build connection break notification
info:
Builds a connection break notification message
and applies rate limiting.

Rate limiting:
- Notifies at count = 5
- Then every 10th failure (15, 25, 35...)
- Returns null (stops flow) if not a notify interval

Output:
- Output 1: POST to Rayvn log
- Output 2: POST to Wasos chat
- msg.payload: [{ content: "⚠️ CONNECTION BREAK..." }]
- msg.message: notification text
